recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下在脂肪為主的骨髓中散見多個肉芽腫，其中數個中央是一個透明圓形脂肪空泡、外圍環繞類上皮組織球與淋巴球，形成甜甜圈樣（doughnut / fibrin-ring）肉芽腫，是 Q 熱（Coxiella burnetii）的典型骨髓表現。
features: Low power: hypocellular fatty marrow with a bony trabecula and several discrete granulomas
Granulomas with a central, sharply round clear lipid vacuole (doughnut configuration)
Central vacuole rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes admixed with lymphocytes
A thin eosinophilic fibrin ring is not clearly resolved on H&E
No caseating necrosis or multinucleated giant cells evident
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypocellular, fat-rich marrow containing multiple discrete non-necrotizing granulomas. Several granulomas have a central, round clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a rim of epithelioid histiocytes and lymphocytes, producing a doughnut configuration. A fibrin ring is not clearly seen on this H&E image and no caseation is present. Findings are consistent with fibrin-ring (doughnut) granulomas, characteristic of but not specific for Coxiella burnetii infection (Q fever); Coxiella serology/PCR, special stains for fibrin and microorganisms, and cultures are recommended.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are often necrotizing with Langhans giant cells and lack a central fat vacuole with fibrin ring; AFB stain and culture separate them.
Lipogranulomas are small aggregates of lipid-laden macrophages around fat droplets without an organized epithelioid cuff or fibrin ring and are clinically incidental.

ddx.dx: EBV, CMV, leishmaniasis or drug (allopurinol) reactions
ddx.vs: These can also produce fibrin-ring granulomas, so serology, PCR and drug history are required to establish Q fever.
Hodgkin shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and sarcoid shows compact tight granulomas without central fat vacuoles.
